plateau_analysis.run_definition: Consecutive records with identical numeric heart_rate; missing or changed values break the run.
plateau_analysis.duration_definition: Elapsed seconds between first and last timestamp; no interpolation or gap filling.

plateau_review.rule: REVIEW if at least one plateau has duration_s > 21.5; otherwise KEEP.
